title: Exploratory study of protective factors against belief in neuromyths in in-service teachers at Brazilian vocational-technical high school.
quote: Among Brazilian vocational-technical in-service teachers, the most prevalent neuromyth was the belief that individuals learn best through their preferred learning style
summary: Estudo com 130 professores técnicos brasileiros: 51,21% endossam neuromitos; o mais comum é o dos estilos de aprendizagem preferidos (87%).
